values.name: Gir National Park
values.location: Sasan Gir and Devalia visitor area, Gujarat
values.description: The Gir landscape is habitat for the Asiatic lion. Visitors can book guided vehicle safaris from Sasan Gir or visit the separate Gir Interpretation Zone at Devalia.
values.seasonal_note: Main jungle safari operates in seasonal slots; advance permits required. Devalia bus safari closes Wednesdays. This application does not enforce dated permit availability.

records.notes: Destination encompasses visitor gateways rather than a fabricated park-centre coordinate; schema has no destination coordinate fields.

values.name: Gir Jungle Safari (Sinh Sadan reporting point)
values.entry_fee: Indian weekday six-seat Type B booking: permit800 + vehicle2000 + guide400 = INR3200; other dates/vehicles/nationalities differ
values.description: A permit-controlled guided vehicle safari through the Gir forest, reporting at Sinh Sadan in Sasan Gir.
values.best_time_note: Stored interval is the official 08:30-11:30 departure slot, not flexible admission. Report30 minutes early with permit and original ID. Other seasonal slots exist. Numeric cost covers one private Type B vehicle booking, not a per-person ticket. Current planner cannot enforce fixed departures or seasonal availability; confirm booking before relying on an itinerary.
values.source: Gujarat Forest Department official booking terms; Google Maps

records.notes: Cost is exact sum of official weekday Indian permit, Type B vehicle and base guide charges. Does not divide by assumed occupancy. Optional camera charge excluded. Map point is reporting campus, not an arbitrary forest centre. No assertion of wheelchair-compatible safari vehicle.

values.name: Devalia Interpretation Zone Bus Safari
values.entry_fee: Indian weekday bus ticket INR150; weekends/festivals INR190; foreign tariffs differ
values.description: Devalia's Gir Interpretation Zone offers a short forest-department bus safari in a managed wildlife area.
values.best_time_note: Official bus slots last30 minutes. Stored window is winter morning service; winter afternoon15:00-17:00 also operates. Summer schedules differ. Closed every Wednesday. Permit availability and exact departure must be checked separately; wheelchair boarding arrangements unverified.
values.source: Gujarat Forest Department official bus booking page; Google Maps

records.notes: Uses current booking page's30-minute slots, not older tourism text stating45 minutes. Current bus page foreign rates also differ from older PDF; no foreign numeric price encoded. Map snapshot pages/gir-devalia-selected.json.

values.name: Anil Farms Gir Jungle Resort
values.description: Anil Farms Gir Jungle Resort offers air-conditioned rooms on garden and mango-orchard grounds near Sasan Gir.
values.source: Official resort website and official-site quote displayed on Google Maps

records.notes: Google official-site nightly quote INR4489 for November24-26 2026, two adults, breakfast included, room/tax basis unspecified, snapshot pages/gir-hotel.json. Official static tariff expired March2026, so not presented as current. Registered Hotel is application category, not a legal registration claim.

values.name: Hotel Gir Kathiyawadi Sasan Gir
values.source: Google Maps; Wanderlog dining guide; Restaurant Guru

records.notes: Wanderlog specifically quotes Gujarati thali INR150; secondary representative meal price, no official current menu. Cross-check Restaurant Guru reports1-200. Map snapshot pages/gir-restaurant.json verifies actual Sasan location despite Wanderlog's broad Somnath area label.
Forest Department brochure describes the broader Gir forest landscape across these three districts. This is the destination landscape, not a claim that each visitor gateway occupies all districts.

values.best_time: Late November to early March (cool and dry season)

records.notes: Forest Department climate description; seasonal preference rather than guaranteed wildlife sightings or permit availability.

research_exclusions: Government web-page accessibility widget describes the website, not safari vehicle accessibility.
Commercial domains presenting themselves as Gir official booking sites excluded.
No assumed per-person split of a private vehicle price.
Fixed safari slots, closures, nationality and party-size pricing are not fully modelled by current planner.
